business_summary: Tohoku Chemical Co., Ltd., a trading company, sells pharmaceuticals, pesticides, food additives, and industrial chemicals and reagents in Japan. The company operates through Medical, Academia, and Life Sciences segments. The company offers chemical industrial reagents/chemical industrial reagent-related apparatus. It also provides clinical diagnostic reagents/clinical diagnostic reagent-related equipment, such as kits inspecting for blood or bacteria helpful for medical examination and diagnosis of various diseases; medical devices that include clinical inspection apparatus and medical imaging systems; and external body diagnosing medicines, medical devices, medical materials, etc. In addition, the company offers food additives/food processing apparatus; and reagents for product inspection analysis, hygiene materials, detergents, pesticides, and water treatment, as well as materials for transfer, analytical inspection, and product development. Further, the company offers agricultural materials, such as pesticides, soil improvement materials, fertilizer, seedling, gardening material, and agriculture-related materials; steel greenhouses for floriculture; and healthcare products. Additionally, it engages in the sale and repair of computers, scientific instruments, medical equipment, educational devices, and measuring equipment; cultivation and sale of flowers; and multifunctional-home care business. Tohoku Chemical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Hirosaki, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 무역 회사인 Tohoku Chemical Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 의약품, 농약, 식품 첨가물, 산업용 화학 물질 및 시약을 판매합니다. 이 회사는 의료, 학계 및 생명 과학 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 화학공업시약/화학공업시약 관련기기를 공급하는 회사입니다. 또한 각종 질병의 진찰 및 진단에 도움이 되는 혈액이나 세균을 검사하는 키트 등 임상진단시약/임상진단시약 관련 장비를 제공합니다. 임상 검사 장치 및 의료 영상 시스템을 포함하는 의료 기기; 및 체외진단 의약품, 의료기기, 의료재료 등을 제공합니다. 또한, 회사는 식품첨가물/식품가공기기; 제품검사분석용 시약, 위생자재, 세제, 농약, 수처리용 시약과 이송용, 분석검사용, 제품개발용 소재 등을 포함하고 있습니다. 또한 농약, 토양개량자재, 비료, 묘목, 원예자재, 농업관련자재 등 농업자재를 제공하고 있습니다. 화훼 재배용 강철 온실; 그리고 헬스케어 제품. 아디
